verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a pre-recorded transcription endpoint (POST /v1/listen) for recorded files, and its dg CLI can transcribe files. The evidence does not show that local binary upload is explicitly supported, and it does not publish accepted audio/video formats or file-size limits, which is half the story. missing for 10: published list of accepted audio/video formats, documented file-size limits, explicit confirmation of local file (binary body) upload versus URL, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a local audio or video file for transcription through a documented API endpoint, with accepted formats and size limits published

citations.quote: Transcribe recorded files (interviews, podcasts, meetings, support calls): POST https://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen with model=nova-3
The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.
